rationale: Compound: ⲡⲱϣ ('division, splitting') + ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ ('of heart'). Distinct from ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛⲍⲏⲧ ('purpose of heart') in glossary. Here in the moral-paraenetic register: division/double-mindedness of heart standing before God as a state of grief — the affect that disqualifies one from meditation upon the divine speech. Could alternatively render διψυχία or μερισμὸς καρδίας.

Probable Lycopolitan reflex of ϥⲱⲃⲉ 'be foul, defiled, leprous.' In moral-ritual register: 'one who is foul' = one in a state of impurity not fit to receive the speech of God. Confidence moderate; flagged for parallel attestations.
Greek loanword μελετᾶν 'to meditate, study, ponder.' Standard verb for spiritual-textual contemplation. Lyc. ⲍ- prefix is dialectal.

Compound: ⲣ̄- ('do') + ⲡⲕⲉ- ('the also') + ⲧⲣ̄- (causative) + ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ ('light') = 'do also the cause-to-be-light' = 'give light additionally.' Used of the two eyes giving light to the body in parallel to the two ships of light illuminating the cosmos.

Compound ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ⲭⲁⲓⲉ (= ϫⲁⲉⲓⲉ 'desert, wilderness, empty place'). The cosmos as the desolate outer region beyond the Father's hidden kingdom. Cf. ⲣ̄ⲭⲁⲓ̈ⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'be made empty' in glossary, same root.

ⲟⲩⲏⲍ qualitative of ⲟⲩⲱⲍ 'place, set, dwell' (Lyc. for ⲟⲩⲱϩ) + ⲍⲓⲍⲟⲩⲛ 'within' (already in glossary). The whole-body location of the inner teaching, corresponding to the hidden seat of the Father's kingship.
